CustomField.description: Expiry urgency signal for Kanban cards and list views. Red at 30 days, amber at 90.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Active")), "—", IF((Lease_End__c - TODAY()) <= 30, "🔴 Critical", IF((Lease_End__c - TODAY()) <= 90, "🟡 Approaching", "🟢 Comfortable")))
CustomField.label: Expiry Health
